hops.rationale: Scope is AAPL, filing year 2023, accession 000032019323000106. The passages directly state the requested dependence on third-party manufacturing and supply-chain risk. Passage 22 says much manufacturing is outsourced to partners in China mainland, India, Japan, South Korea, Taiwan and Vietnam, that a significant share is concentrated with a few partners often in single locations, and that outsourcing reduces direct control over production. Passage 23 says the company relies on single-source outsourcing partners for many components and on Asia-based partners for final assembly of substantially all hardware, that partner failures can affect cost or supply, and that it obtains some components from single or limited sources. Passage 17 adds that disruptions at contract manufacturers and suppliers can impair manufacturing and delivery. Together these cover the core facts. Filing year 2023 with fiscal period ending September 30, 2023 matches the catalog.

hops.query: third-party manufacturing supply chain dependence risk
hops.requested_goal: find the disclosed dependence on third-party manufacturing and supply-chain risks
hops.rationale: The NVDA FY2024 10-K passages directly state the required dependence on third-party manufacturing and supply-chain risk. Passage 41 says NVDA uses third parties to manufacture and assemble products, has long manufacturing lead times, and receives no guaranteed wafer, component or capacity supply. It also notes that sales can be impeded when third-party components are unavailable. Passage 49 says dependency on third-party suppliers to manufacture, assemble, test or package products reduces control over quantity, quality, yields and delivery schedules. It states NVDA relies on foundries for wafers and on independent subcontractors for assembly, test and component procurement, and lists supply risks such as decommitments and higher wafer prices. Passage 35 summarizes the same risk, and passage 58 adds third-party supply-chain security exposure. Together these fully cover the requested goal within NVDA 2024 scope.
